about.p-the-equipment-matches-that-promi: The equipment matches that promise: a tour-grade launch monitor, real course simulation, and an enclosure built to handle a full night of swings without a wrinkle. We price it fair for what it is, a premium experience without a premium markup.
about.p-we-started-with-a-simple-idea: We started with a simple idea: everybody wants to swing a golf club, and almost nobody gets the chance at a party. So we built a golf course that travels, complete with the person who runs it.
about.p-we-stay-hands-on-through-the-who: We stay hands-on through the whole thing. We build the enclosure, run the launch monitor, and stick around for the entire event, so your guests get a host who runs the show from first swing to last.
about.p-were-alabama-based-and-alabama-r: We're Alabama-based and Alabama-run, and we travel to every corner of the state, from Huntsville to Mobile.

events.p-birthdays-graduations-bachelor-: Birthdays, graduations, bachelor and bachelorette parties, and family reunions. Whatever the occasion, we bring the entertainment to it.
events.p-booster-events-athletic-banquet: Booster events, athletic banquets, and program fundraisers that give supporters something worth lining up for.
events.p-built-for-a-crowd-an-attendant: Built for a crowd. An attendant keeps rotations moving so more guests get their swing in less time.
events.p-closest-to-the-pin-and-long-dri: Closest-to-the-pin and long-drive contests raise real dollars for your cause, with an attendant handling every swing.
events.p-contest-formats-move-a-line-far: Contest formats move a line far faster than full rounds, so a crowd cycles through in the window you actually have. Set your own entry price and run as many rounds as the night allows.
events.p-give-guests-something-to-do-bet: Give guests something to do between the ceremony and the first dance. We set it up, we run it, you enjoy the reception.
events.p-guests-walk-up-and-start-swingi: Guests walk up and start swinging within minutes, no lesson required. The simulator runs settings built for total beginners right next to modes serious players respect, so a first-timer and a scratch golfer end up on the same leaderboard.
events.p-if-people-gather-there-a-golf: If people gather there, a golf simulator fits right in. Indoors or outdoors, day or night, anywhere in Alabama.
events.p-product-launches-client-days-ho: Product launches, client days, holiday parties, and trade show booths. Branded leaderboards give visitors a reason to stop and stay.
events.p-send-the-date-the-city-and: Send the date, the city, and a rough guest count. We reply by email with availability and pricing, usually within one business day.

faq.p-an-attendant-runs-rotations-the-wh: An attendant runs rotations the whole time, so most groups get everyone through several swings over the course of the event. Expecting a big crowd or a tight window? Tell us the guest count when you request a quote. Closest-to-the-pin and long-drive formats move a line much faster than full rounds, and booking a longer window gives everyone a turn without rushing.
faq.p-anywhere-in-alabama-events-near-ou: Anywhere in Alabama. Events near our home base carry no travel fee. Farther trips may add a mileage charge, and we'll spell that out clearly before you book.
faq.p-none-the-simulator-runs-games-and: None. The simulator runs games and difficulty settings built for total beginners right alongside modes serious players respect. Kids, first-timers, and low-handicap regulars all end up on the same leaderboard.
faq.p-one-standard-outlet-within-about-1: One standard outlet within about 100 feet of the setup area covers it. We bring a heavy-duty extension cord and run the power ourselves, so all you do is point us to the plug. If your venue has no power at all, mention it when you request a quote and we'll sort out the arrangements well before your date.
faq.p-our-enclosure-runs-about-15-feet: Our enclosure runs about 15 feet deep, 14 feet wide, and 11 feet tall. Garages, ballrooms, gyms, parking lots, and backyards all work well. We'll confirm your exact space during booking so there are no surprises on event day.
faq.p-the-simulator-moves-indoors-in-min: The simulator moves indoors in minutes. If your venue has a covered space, we relocate there and keep the party going. If it doesn't, we'll work with you on a reschedule rather than call it off.
faq.p-we-arrive-about-an-hour-before: We arrive about an hour before your start time and are fully packed out within an hour of your last swing. You won't see a cable during the party.
faq.p-we-hold-your-date-with-a: We hold your date with a signed agreement and a deposit, both handled during the quote process. The remaining balance is due closer to your event date, and everything is spelled out before you sign.

index.p-every-booking-comes-with-a-train: Every booking comes with a trained attendant who runs the simulator from setup to the last swing. Live ball flight and real course data play out on a big screen inside an enclosure built for a full night of play. Guests show up as they are and start swinging within minutes, first-timers and scratch golfers alike. We're a small Alabama operation: the same person who answers your call runs your event.
